protocol.scope: Known development generator, not independent final validation
protocol.target: Exceedance at each target date, not any crossing during the interval
protocol.baselines: Last observed out-of-tolerance state within each eligible history; plus Gaussian persistence sharing the model predictive std on its available subset; abstain if latest date ambiguous
protocol.metrics_scope: Model available subset; paired baseline comparison; baseline own subset; compare estimator heads only on common available forecasts
